"Enable the Equalizer or any Effect before opening your media player.
Equalizer attaches itself to the media player that is currently playing. Most media players let other apps to apply effects to their songs, some require additional configuration, but some do not allow other apps to apply effects to their songs. Depending on this, the equalizer may not attach itself to some media players and will attach itself to the Global Mix to support these players, eg. YouTube (this may not work on all the devices).
If you are using Spotify or Youtube Music, make sure you restart them while keeping the equalizer or any effect enabled.
Equalizer will also show the notification when it detects any media player, tap on the notification to attach the equalizer to that media player.
Also, turn off all the battery optimizations for this app for a better experience.
Now, play some music and enjoy the equalizer."
